value_text: $7,750,000 over a 5-year Subscription Term (Oct 15, 2025 – Oct 14, 2030), payable as Annual Commitments of $1,550,000.
9% off list DBU rate, held flat for the Subscription Term.
Business Critical Support priced at 22% of the Committed Purchase Amount, invoiced alongside Platform Services fees.
Unused Annual Commitment in a given Contract Year is forfeited at that Contract Year's anniversary; it does not carry forward.
DBU usage above the Annual Commitment in a given Contract Year is billed at list rate (no Platform Services Discount) at the annual true-up.
Fees for each Contract Year are invoiced annually, in advance, Net 30 from invoice date.
Absent written non-renewal notice at least 90 days before Subscription Term end, this Order Form renews automatically for successive one-year terms at Databricks' then-current list rates.
Customer may terminate only for Databricks' uncured material breach; no termination for convenience.
